title: Lyla
creator: CrossFit
description: A 10-to-1 ladder of muscle-ups and bodyweight clean and jerks: 10 of each, then 9, down to 1. One of the 2021 Girls and one of the hardest — 55 muscle-ups and 55 heavy clean and jerks. Scale the muscle-ups to pull-ups plus dips and drop the bar to a fraction of bodyweight.
